themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints spiked to 119 THIS WEEK versus a baseline of 28.8 per week, a 314% increase (z-score: 6.4), coinciding with widespread damage reports including 5 damaged tree complaints THIS WEEK (208% above baseline) and 12 sidewalk condition complaints 2 WEEKS AGO (269% above baseline), suggesting acute infrastructure deterioration across the district.
evidence: Street condition complaints: 119 THIS WEEK vs. 28.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 6.4, severity: high)
Damaged tree complaints: 5 THIS WEEK vs. 1.6 weekly average (208% spike, z-score: 3.94)
Sidewalk condition complaints: 12 two weeks ago vs. 3.2 weekly average (269% spike, z-score: 3.75)
reporting_angles: Walking audit: document specific street segments, sidewalk hazards, and tree damage hotspots; interview residents about safety concerns and trip-and-fall risks
City response timeline: when does DOT respond to these complaints, and is the district adequately staffed for maintenance? Connect to repeated CB budget requests for street capital projects

themes_detail.label: Street Sweeping Service Collapse
themes_detail.summary: Street sweeping complaints exploded to 4 complaints 2 WEEKS AGO from a baseline of 0.4 per week, a 967% spike (z-score: 7.49, highest severity), indicating potential service breakdown or accumulation of street debris across the district.
evidence: Street sweeping complaints: 4 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.4 weekly average (967% spike, z-score: 7.49, marked as highest severity)
Pattern suggests either new service failure or accumulation event 2 weeks ago with ongoing impact
reporting_angles: DSNY staffing and scheduling: was there a staffing shortage, schedule change, or vehicle breakdown 2 weeks ago in Far Rockaway?
Ground truth reporting: are streets visibly dirtier now than baseline? Document specific blocks with debris accumulation

themes_detail.label: For-Hire Vehicle Surge
themes_detail.summary: For-hire vehicle complaints spiked to 3 complaints 2 WEEKS AGO from a baseline of 0.2 per week, a 1100% increase (z-score: 6.35, high severity), suggesting emerging issues with Uber/Lyft or other app-based transportation in the district.
evidence: For-hire vehicle complaints: 3 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.2 weekly average (1100% spike, z-score: 6.35, severity: high)
First significant spike in this complaint category, suggesting new or escalating service issue
reporting_angles: Driver behavior: are complaints about aggressive driving, parking violations, or illegal pickups in residential areas?
Service expansion: has a for-hire platform recently launched or expanded coverage in the Rockaways?
Congestion and safety: interview residents about how the spike has affected street safety and parking availability

themes_detail.label: Police-Related Incident Surge
themes_detail.summary: Non-emergency police matter complaints jumped to 7 complaints THIS WEEK versus a baseline of 1.5 per week, a 367% spike (z-score: 4.92, high severity), suggesting emerging safety or quality-of-life disturbances requiring investigation.
evidence: Non-emergency police matter complaints: 7 THIS WEEK vs. 1.5 weekly average (367% spike, z-score: 4.92, severity: high)
No prior context available; requires on-the-ground reporting to identify nature of incidents
reporting_angles: Incident clustering: are complaints concentrated in specific neighborhoods or time periods this week? Map hotspots.
Complaint details: what types of non-emergency incidents are driving this spike—loud gatherings, disorderly conduct, quality-of-life issues?
NYPD response: interview precinct commanders about any known patterns or operational changes

themes_detail.label: Animal Control & Park Safety Issue
themes_detail.summary: Animal in a park complaints reached 9 complaints 2 WEEKS AGO from a baseline of 1.8 per week, a 414% spike (z-score: 3.65, high severity), suggesting potential wildlife or stray animal problems affecting public park use and resident safety.
evidence: Animal in a park complaints: 9 two weeks ago vs. 1.8 weekly average (414% spike, z-score: 3.65, severity: high)
CB budget history shows repeated requests for park development and amenity improvements; animal issue may deter park use
reporting_angles: Species and behavior: what animals are being reported—aggressive dogs, rats, coyotes? Have incidents involved injuries?
Park condition: are parks in deteriorated condition, attracting wildlife? Connect to sidewalk/street damage spike and infrastructure budget requests
Parks Department response: how quickly does NYC Parks respond to animal complaints in this district?
